entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3324153371114695680: position at J2016.0. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, SV Mon: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1978.6 +/- 95 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1978.6 +/- 95 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.4324 +/- 0.0321 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01), 13.5 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 0.745, -1.811 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 71.6 +/- 3.5 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, SV Mon: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 71.6 +/- 3.5 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5375 +/- 406 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 157, Name='SV Mon', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5375 +/- 406 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,375 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.234 +/- 0.009 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffecdd. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,375 K and log g 0.7 (u1 0.538, u2 0.184): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 0.7 from 2023A&A...678A.195D, the median of its 5 spectra; the 12 published values span log g 0.7 to 1.5, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.2% of the centre brightness.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 3324153371114695680: 3 G-band harmonics of a 15.229709339395576 d period, peak-to-peak 0.647 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.05 of a cycle there.
